title: Single-molecule magnet behaviour in a tetranuclear DyIII complex formed from a novel tetrazine-centered hydrazone Schiff base ligand

material_class.structural_family: tetrazine-bridged tetranuclear Ln4 cluster of two dinuclear subunits

synthesis.procedure: A room-temperature suspension of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (114 mg, 0.25 mmol) and H2vht (51 mg, 0.125 mmol) in MeOH was stirred for 5 min, after which NaN3 (16 mg, 0.25 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred for another 30 min, filtered, and the filtrate was left to stand in a sealed vial. After 2 days, black block-shaped crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction were obtained.
synthesis.time: stirred 5 min, then 30 min after NaN3; crystals after 2 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred suspension, filtration, crystallization in a sealed vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left to stand in a sealed vial; black block crystals after 2 days

properties.summary: Weak intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling between Dy ions; χT = 55.81 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, rising to 69.86 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.9 K. SMM behaviour under zero dc field with Ueff = 158 K and τ0 = 1.06 × 10−7 s (Arrhenius, T > 15 K). Frequency-dependent ac susceptibility and Cole–Cole α = 0.25–0.41. Magnetisation 27.40 μB at 5 T and 2.0 K. Micro-SQUID hysteresis with opening below 0.5 K (0.14 T s−1) up to 4 K. Magellan easy axes nearly collinear (7°) within Dy2 subunits.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, thermally activated regime above 15 K; Arrhenius from τ(T) between 5 and 18 K

measurements.name: Cole–Cole α
measurements.conditions: generalized Debye, 7–20 K, zero dc field

measurements.name: hysteresis opening
measurements.conditions: micro-SQUID; below 0.5 K at 0.14 T s−1; step between 0 and 0.2 T

source_locations.location: Magnetic measurements; χT Fig. 4; ac Fig. 5–6; hysteresis Fig. 7

synthesis.time: same as 1: stirred 5 min, then 30 min after NaN3; crystals analogous to 1
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same as 1: stirred suspension, filtration, sealed-vial crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: black block-shaped crystals suitable for SCXRD

properties.summary: Isotropic Gd4 analogue with weak ferromagnetic coupling modelled by one J for two well-separated dimers: J = 0.009(3) cm−1, g = 1.982(1). χT = 30.81 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, rising to 33.73 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.9 K. Magnetisation 25.49 μB at 5 T and 1.9 K; M vs. HT−1 curves superimpose, consistent with isotropic GdIII.

measurements.conditions: isotropic Hamiltonian Ĥ = −2J(Ŝa·Ŝb + Ŝa·Ŝb), Sa = Sb = 7/2; one-J dimer model
